description: Spec m0-pipeline: npm + GitHub Actions, weekly; npm patch/minor automerged after CI.

packageRules.description: Patch, minor and digest updates merge themselves once every check is green.
Never automerge GitHub Actions: workflows hold write tokens and the Claude secret.
Surfer drives the Firefox build; a build on the runner must prove it first.
Node (.nvmrc) comes as its own PR and never merges itself: the bench baseline is keyed on the exact version, so that PR records the new key (docs/runbook.md, Bench baseline).
